svg.aria-label: Layer 1 asks Jev which pattern the requirement follows. Its answer, has_condition 1.00, is placed in the context for layer 2 next to the same statement. Layer 2 asks whether the condition and response are stated and gets 0.78, which goes on to the expert check.
